breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly specified both Dirichlet and Periodic boundary conditions. The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent's generated specification correctly omits the contradictory periodic condition and only includes the instruction to 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions u = 0 on all four edges of the domain', thus resolving the inconsistency.
